small_claim_mapping_checks.residual_status: Mapping residual only. Reported balance is primarily, not entirely, AMIC; Q4 CFO and ordinary tax budgets are not decomposed enough to exclude overlap. No automatic correction credited.
small_claim_mapping_checks.debt_status: Sept26 gross carrying-to-fair-value mark only; not a matched Dec2026 or Dec2030 financing bridge. Do not credit as corrected value.
small_claim_mapping_checks.SLP_status: Collection is conversion of a recognized asset; adding cash requires removing receivable. Face accretion is not a fresh .5B asset.

interpretation: The funding response restores the chosen quarter-end buffer conditionally; it does not create operating value or improve the margin of safety.
Facility capacity and maturities are reported; future availability and illustrative cost are not guaranteed.
Tax shields are conditional and separately shown. No financing-derived uplift is credited to planning value.
The after-tax interest reduction to the 2030 target is not a second interest subtraction from unlevered operating DCF.
No contract fee schedule or daily liquidity path reconstructed. Original no-draw cases remain valid operating/timing stresses.
